criterion: An era boundary is a hard power transition in the channel's own monthly spectrogram, dated by the author; frequency drift never cuts an era. Months strictly between one era's last month and the next era's first month belong to no era. A first month may be dated, from an external record, to a month before the era's first populated month when no frame lies between them; the era's frames are then those of its populated months.
